acceptance: Fresh positive refunds within remaining capture settle once.
retry: A settled key with the same amount succeeds without changing totals or effects, including when capture is exhausted.
conflict: A settled key with a different amount is rejected without effects.
rejection: Invalid fresh requests leave state unchanged and do not reserve keys.
scope: Sequential in-memory refunds; no provider, persistence or concurrency.
authority: Local experiment expectation from refund obligations and authorized milestone 3; no trusted CI provenance.
